chunks: It is He who sends down to His servant clear verses, so that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light; and indeed, Allah is to you Kind and Merciful.

key_terms.الظُّلُمَاتِ: darknesses (plural, indicating multiple layers or types of ignorance)
key_terms.لِيَخْرِجَكُمْ: so that He may bring you out

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of bringing people from darkness to light in Surah Al-Hadid?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked to the descent of the Qur'an upon the Prophet Muhammad, with 'clear signs' (Ayat Bayyinat) interpreted as both the textual revelation and the Ahl al-Bayt, who serve as the living guides leading believers from the darkness of ignorance to the light of divine knowledge. The transition from 'darkness' to 'light' underscores the Shia emphasis on the necessity of Imamate for spiritual illumination, while the concluding attributes of Rahman and Raheem highlight God's mercy as the foundation for this guidance.
